selection_rule: available AND exact skill AND exact region; minimize (load,id)
task_mix: 60% routine, 20% absent skill, 10% missing field, 10% unauthorized
context_measure: UTF-8 JSON bytes, NOT model tokens
timing: Python perf_counter_ns; includes context construction/serialization and dispatch decision; excludes oracle, generation and index build (reported separately)
design: Manually authored candidates frozen in source before test. Choose on development correctness and bytes. Test requests held out; no subsequent fitting.
